title: Protocols
morning-light.name: Morning light
morning-light.how: Get outside and look toward the sun, never straight at it. No sunglasses, and not through a window.
morning-light.notify: The sun is up. Step outside and look toward it, best before %1.
morning-light.notifyLate: Past the ideal window, but morning light still counts until %1. Step outside now.
evening-light.name: Evening light
evening-light.how: Catch the low sun before it sets. It steadies your body clock and softens the effect of bright light later tonight.
evening-light.notify: The sun is low. Step outside and look toward it before it sets at %1.
evening-light.notifyLate: The sun is low. Step outside and look toward it before it sets at %1.
sky.clear: Clear sky: about %1 minutes outside is enough.
sky.unknown: Stay out 5-10 minutes if it's clear, 15-20 if cloudy, 30 if overcast.
popup.noLocation: Location unknown. Connect to the network, or set a location in the weather panel.
popup.noSun: The sun does not rise or set here today.
settings.title: Settings
settings.bedHelp: Dim the lights starts two hours before.
morning-hydration.name: Morning hydration
morning-hydration.how: Drink 16–32 US fl oz (about 500 mL–1 L) of water soon after waking. Electrolytes are optional; Huberman includes them in his personal routine. The reminder runs for six hours from your wake time.
morning-hydration.notify: Drink 16–32 US fl oz (about 500 mL–1 L) of water after waking. Electrolytes are optional. This reminder stays open until %1.
morning-hydration.notifyLate: Drink 16–32 US fl oz (about 500 mL–1 L) of water after waking. Electrolytes are optional. This reminder stays open until %1.
nsdr.name: NSDR
nsdr.how: Non-sleep deep rest: lie down and follow a guided NSDR or yoga nidra recording. Ten minutes helps; aim for 20–30. The reminder runs from 2 to 5 p.m., when the afternoon dip usually lands, but a session works at any time of day.
nsdr.notify: Afternoon dip? Lie down for a 10–30 minute NSDR or yoga nidra session, any time before %1.
nsdr.notifyLate: Afternoon dip? Lie down for a 10–30 minute NSDR or yoga nidra session, any time before %1.
dim-lights.name: Dim the lights
dim-lights.how: From 10 p.m. to 4 a.m., avoid bright light, especially overhead lights. Use only as much light as you need to move about safely. Candlelight and moonlight are fine. Start earlier if you can: in the two hours before bed, keep lights low and warm and put screens away for the last hour. The reminder arrives two hours before your bedtime.
dim-lights.notify: Two hours to bedtime. Turn off the overhead lights, keep the rest low and warm, and put screens away for the last hour.
dim-lights.notifyLate: Two hours to bedtime. Turn off the overhead lights, keep the rest low and warm, and put screens away for the last hour.
dim-lights.due: Keep the lights low and warm
